Art_Unlawful_Discharge.title: Unlawful Discharge
Art_Unlawful_Discharge.rule_text: The unlawful discharge article covers an excessive pollutant release and carries a fine or short detention.

Art_Hazardous_Waste_Dumping.title: Hazardous Waste Dumping
Art_Hazardous_Waste_Dumping.rule_text: The hazardous waste dumping article covers hazardous material disposed without protection and carries imprisonment of not more than 3 years.

Art_Serious_Contamination.title: Serious Contamination
Art_Serious_Contamination.rule_text: The serious contamination article covers excessive pollutant release that causes environmental harm and carries imprisonment of between 7 and 15 years.

Art_Falsified_Monitoring.title: Falsified Monitoring
Art_Falsified_Monitoring.rule_text: The falsified monitoring article covers excessive pollutant release accompanied by manipulation of monitoring information and carries imprisonment of between 3 and 7 years.

Art_Valid_Permit_Defense.title: Valid Permit Defense
Art_Valid_Permit_Defense.rule_text: The valid permit defense covers excessive pollutant release that remains within valid permit records and carries no criminal liability.

Art_Emergency_Release_Defense.title: Emergency Release Defense
Art_Emergency_Release_Defense.rule_text: The emergency release defense covers excessive pollutant release that is necessary to prevent an imminent explosion and is promptly reported; it carries no criminal liability.

rules.name: release_facts_imply_pollutant_release
rules.natural_text: A pollutant release includes any one of the following: wastewater discharge, air emissions, or a leaking storage tank.

rules.name: exceedance_fact_implies_limit_exceedance
rules.natural_text: Limit exceedance means that the pollutant level exceeds the applicable limit.

rules.name: hazard_facts_imply_hazardous_material
rules.natural_text: Hazardous material includes either hazardous solvent or heavy-metal sludge.

rules.name: dumping_facts_imply_unprotected_disposal
rules.natural_text: Unprotected disposal includes either transport to an unlined site or burial without a liner.

rules.name: harm_facts_imply_environmental_harm
rules.natural_text: Environmental harm includes any one of the following: a fish kill, closure of a drinking-water intake, or confirmed soil contamination.

rules.name: report_facts_imply_report_manipulation
rules.natural_text: Monitoring manipulation includes any one of the following: omitting an exceedance, changing a sampling date, or disabling a sensor during release.

rules.name: permit_facts_imply_permit_records
rules.natural_text: Permit records require a valid discharge permit, release within scope, and submitted monitoring.

rules.name: emergency_facts_imply_emergency_records
rules.natural_text: Emergency records require imminent equipment failure, release necessity to prevent explosion, and prompt notice to the authority.

rules.name: release_and_exceedance_imply_unlawful_release_basis
rules.natural_text: Unlawful release is based on pollutant release together with limit exceedance.

rules.name: hazard_and_disposal_imply_hazardous_dumping_basis
rules.natural_text: Hazardous dumping is based on hazardous material together with unprotected disposal.

rules.name: unlawful_release_and_harm_imply_serious_contamination_basis
rules.natural_text: Serious contamination is based on unlawful release together with environmental harm.

rules.name: unlawful_release_and_report_manipulation_imply_monitoring_falsification_basis
rules.natural_text: Monitoring falsification is based on unlawful release together with monitoring manipulation.

rules.name: unlawful_release_and_permit_records_imply_permit_authorization
rules.natural_text: Permit authorization requires unlawful-release facts plus complete permit records.

rules.name: unlawful_release_and_emergency_records_imply_emergency_release_authorization
rules.natural_text: Emergency release authorization requires unlawful-release facts plus complete emergency records.
